pack.topic: Plinth Beam vs Lintel Beam: Structural Position & Role
pack.source_script_insight: The source video uses high-contrast vertical visual movement to clearly distinguish between two key mechanical components located at the bottom (crankshaft) and top (camshaft) of a system. We adapt this visual mapping mechanism to civil construction by showing the physical placement and functional difference between bottom Plinth Beams and upper Lintel Beams in a residential house frame.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In fast-growing residential hubs around Coimbatore like Vadavalli and Saravanampatti, plot buyers often see concrete beams poured at ground level and window height without understanding why both are essential. Clarifying lower vs upper beam positions helps homeowners verify structural completeness during site visits.
pack.core_takeaway: Plinth beams at soil level transfer structural wall loads safely to the foundation, while lintel beams above openings carry loads over doors and windows.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production Script for OliveTree Builders, COIMBATORE ONLY. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS total duration. EXACTLY 7 SCENES. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE, 90%+ real-looking visuals in vertical portrait 9:16 aspect ratio. No cartoon, no 3D animation, no fake render. Set in realistic active residential site in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, featuring red soil, red clay bricks, M-sand concrete, and natural bright tropical daylight.

SCENE 1 (0.0s - 1.4s): Low-angle upward camera movement rising from damp Coimbatore red soil base to upper brick wall of a contemporary home skeleton. Text overlay: 'PLINTH VS LINTEL?'. Tamil VO: 'வீட்டின் கீழ் பீம், மேல் பீம் வித்தியாசம் தெரியுமா?'.

SCENE 2 (1.4s - 2.8s): Ground-level close-up shot showing TMT steel rebar cage inside timber shuttering at plot ground surface. High physical detail of wire ties, coarse granite aggregate, and wet sand. Text overlay: 'PLINTH BEAM'. Tamil VO: 'கீழே இருப்பது பிளின்த் பீம்!'.

SCENE 3 (2.8s - 4.2s): Smooth horizontal tracking shot along freshly poured concrete plinth beam resting directly above trench foundation. Transparent yellow load arrows pointing downward overlay the beam. Text overlay: 'LOAD DISTRIBUTION'. Tamil VO: 'இது அடித்தள சுமையை பரப்பும்.'.

SCENE 4 (4.2s - 5.6s): Vertical tilt upward following red wire-cut brick masonry course towards a wooden window frame opening. Dust particles visible in daylight beam. Text overlay: 'WINDOW LEVEL'. Tamil VO: 'ஜன்னலுக்கு மேல் வருவது...'.

SCENE 5 (5.6s - 7.0s): Eye-level focal shot showing continuous cast-in-situ concrete lintel beam spanning across top of a teak window frame. Text overlay: 'LINTEL BEAM'. Tamil VO: 'லின்டெல் பீம்!'.

SCENE 6 (7.0s - 8.5s): Action shot of a Tamil construction mason applying cement mortar atop the lintel beam, building upper brick course. Text overlay: 'FRAME SAFETY'. Tamil VO: 'இது கதவு, ஜன்னல் எடையை தாங்கும்.'.

SCENE 7 (8.5s - 10.0s): Pull-back wide exterior scene of two-story reinforced frame house in Vadavalli, Coimbatore under clear sunlight with subtle text 'OliveTree Builders'. Text overlay: 'STRONG STRUCTURE'. Tamil VO: 'சரியான அமைப்பே பலமான வீடு!'.

CONTINUITY & ATMOSPHERE: Real Tamil Nadu active site ambiance, authentic construction worker wear, local red clay brickwork, true 9:16 vertical smartphone frame setup. Direct realistic sunlight and shadows.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: Do not include full screen logo end card, glossy 3D CGI animation, floating futuristic CAD diagrams, non-Tamil Nadu settings, blue ice, snow, exaggerated fake sound effects, text overlay over 4 words, landscape view, black sidebars, or white background explainer graphic style.
